# release-compensation-runner

Behavior contract:
release/service.cjs exports async execute(steps). Each step is {name, apply, rollback}; validate the ENTIRE array before execution: names are nonempty distinct strings and both callbacks functions, otherwise throw TypeError without calling any callback. Run apply() sequentially, awaiting each result token. On complete success return tokens in order, with no rollback. On any apply failure, do not run later apply callbacks; await rollback(token) for each previously successful step in reverse order. Do not roll back the failed step itself. Continue rolling back even if one rollback fails. Finally throw AggregateError whose errors array contains the original apply error first, followed by rollback errors in occurrence order, retaining exact error identities. Do not mutate the plan. Callbacks may throw synchronously or reject.

Run `node --test tests/behavior.test.cjs`.
Use only the runtime standard library. Preserve public interfaces and existing assertions; do not install dependencies or access the network.
